title: Absence of Structured Data Markup on Service Page
description: The /services page does not implement JSON-LD structured data (such as Service or WebPage schema). While missing structured data is not an explicit technical error, schema markup helps search engines interpret page entity attributes more effectively.
potential_technical_impact: التأثير على تجربة الزوار أو فاعلية الفهرسة.
recommended_action: Assess adding Service or WebPage structured data using JSON-LD to clearly define offered capabilities.

title: Unspecified Language and Internationalization Metadata
description: Content on the site is written in Arabic, but explicit hreflang annotations were not detected in the provided page crawl data.
potential_technical_impact: التأثير على تجربة الزوار أو فاعلية الفهرسة.
recommended_action: Verify that the HTML lang attribute is set to 'ar' and determine if multi-regional targeting via hreflang is necessary.
